summary: New Orleans should retain a true standalone municipal control row. Official City and NOPD sources show a real citywide policing surface with eight NOPD districts, an exclusive LANPD0000 municipal crosswalk, and continuing local 2024 police-data publication. The problem is broken 2024 federal continuity, not bad routing. The current all-fill row should not be accepted as a final anchor; replace it with a targeted six-offense local override built from NOPD's 2024 annual preliminary crime publication and the SVD annual UCR rape publication, while keeping the Electronic Police Report dataset as audit/reconciliation support rather than the production count source.
